users.structure:
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `nickname` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `avatar_path` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs DEFAULT NULL,
  `auth_token_hash` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs DEFAULT NULL,
  `auth_expires_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_users_username` (`username`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_users_auth_token_hash` (`auth_token_hash`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_users_auth_pair` CHECK ((((`auth_token_hash` is null) and (`auth_expires_at` is null)) or ((`auth_token_hash` is not null) and (`auth_expires_at` is not null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

categories.structure:
CREATE TABLE `categories` (
  `id` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `sort_order` smallint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_categories_name` (`name`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_categories_sort` CHECK ((`sort_order` between 1 and 7))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

clothes.structure:
CREATE TABLE `clothes` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `category_id` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `image_path` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `color` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `season` varchar(8) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `note` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `is_archived` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_clothes_user_archived_id` (`user_id`,`is_archived`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_clothes_category` (`category_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_clothes_category` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `categories` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_clothes_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_clothes_archived` CHECK ((`is_archived` in (0,1))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_clothes_season` CHECK ((`season` in (_utf8mb4'春',_utf8mb4'夏',_utf8mb4'秋',_utf8mb4'冬',_utf8mb4'春夏',_utf8mb4'春秋',_utf8mb4'秋冬',_utf8mb4'四季')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

outfits.structure:
CREATE TABLE `outfits` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `occasion` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `note` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `is_archived` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_outfits_user_archived_id` (`user_id`,`is_archived`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_outfits_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_outfits_archived` CHECK ((`is_archived` in (0,1)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

outfit_items.structure:
CREATE TABLE `outfit_items` (
  `outfit_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `clothing_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `sort_order` smallint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`outfit_id`,`clothing_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_outfit_items_order` (`outfit_id`,`sort_order`),
  KEY `idx_outfit_items_clothing` (`clothing_id`,`outfit_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_outfit_items_clothing` FOREIGN KEY (`clothing_id`) REFERENCES `clothes` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_outfit_items_outfit` FOREIGN KEY (`outfit_id`) REFERENCES `outfits` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_outfit_items_sort` CHECK ((`sort_order` >= 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

diaries.structure:
CREATE TABLE `diaries` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `wear_date` date NOT NULL,
  `source_outfit_id` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `occasion` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `mood` varchar(12) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs DEFAULT NULL,
  `photo_path` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs DEFAULT NULL,
  `note` varchar(1000) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_diaries_user_date` (`user_id`,`wear_date`),
  KEY `idx_diaries_source_outfit` (`source_outfit_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_diaries_source` FOREIGN KEY (`source_outfit_id`) REFERENCES `outfits` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_diaries_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

diary_items.structure:
CREATE TABLE `diary_items` (
  `diary_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `clothing_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `sort_order` smallint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`diary_id`,`clothing_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_diary_items_order` (`diary_id`,`sort_order`),
  KEY `idx_diary_items_clothing` (`clothing_id`,`diary_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_diary_items_clothing` FOREIGN KEY (`clothing_id`) REFERENCES `clothes` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_diary_items_diary` FOREIGN KEY (`diary_id`) REFERENCES `diaries` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_diary_items_sort` CHECK ((`sort_order` >= 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs
